nodes.label: Ledge Identity
nodes.rationale: Turns a user's own photos into a persistent, user-controlled Identity Profile reused for identity-consistent images and clips; trust is a product requirement because likeness carries biometric and impersonation risk.

nodes.label: Identity Consent Capture (FR-002)
nodes.rationale: Standalone, immutable likeness consent; no model training by default.

nodes.label: Fail Closed on Safety (no generate, no charge)
